reasoning_trace: AgyOptInRequiredError is a ConfigError (types.py:503); cheval.py:2544-2553 'except ChevalError' records error_class UNKNOWN, prints _error_json(code, message, retryable) and returns; _error_json (cheval.py:142-146) and ChevalError.to_json never serialise context, so failure_class opt_in_required is unreachable on the wire; every stock Google fallback_chain ends in google:gemini-headless (model-config.yaml:216,228,248,262,289); _companion_failure_class (adversarial-review.sh:2979-2995) has no opt_in_required class.
finding: Opt-in refusal inside the chain walk hard-aborts with INVALID_CONFIG, masking the upstream Google HTTP failure and counting as a failed voice; the documented machine-readable failure_class seam is never emitted.

remediation: Catch AgyOptInRequiredError before the generic ChevalError arm: record OPT_IN_REQUIRED in models_failed, keep the previous hop's exception, continue; or drop gemini-headless from the resolved chain at plan time when the opt-in is off. Serialise failure_class in _error_json; teach _companion_failure_class the class; add a two-hop test.
